domain_title: Architecture, security, robustness, safety and evaluation
title: Prompt-only or model-mediated security boundary
canonical_definition: Security-critical restrictions depend mainly on instructions, refusals, model behavior or unverified filters instead of enforceable external controls and adversarial evidence.

conditions: All AI systems; attack modules are selected by model type, data flow, exposure, learning behavior, retrieval and agent authority.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Prompt-only or model-mediated security boundary: Security-critical restrictions depend mainly on instructions, refusals, model behavior or unverified filters instead of enforceable external controls and adversarial evidence.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show safety prompts as the principal control, model output reaching tools directly, or missing adversarial testing?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Prompt-only or model-mediated security boundary, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Safety prompt is the principal control
Model output reaches tools or interpreters directly
Untrusted retrieved content can alter privileged behavior

conditions: Refer verified prompt-only or model-mediated security boundary to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MEASURE 2.7 (PDF p. 35), MEASURE 2.13 (PDF p. 35), MAP 4.2 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on evaluating security and resilience, validating evaluation methods and mapping component controls. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where the principal security boundary depends on model instructions, refusals or unverified filtering alone. The mechanism can have an operational effect where authorized verification shows untrusted model output reaching a consequential action without independent policy enforcement.
potential_consequences: A model-mediated failure can expose assets or allow actions outside authorized policy.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether the principal security boundary depends on model instructions, refusals or unverified filtering alone. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether authorized verification shows untrusted model output reaching a consequential action without independent policy enforcement. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review scope-aware review of actual enforcement points, controlled denied-action cases, regression results and operational alert coverage. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether the principal security boundary depends on model instructions, refusals or unverified filtering alone. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether authorized verification shows untrusted model output reaching a consequential action without independent policy enforcement. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide scope-aware review of actual enforcement points, controlled denied-action cases, regression results and operational alert coverage. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Scope-aware review of actual enforcement points, controlled denied-action cases, regression results and operational alert coverage.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether the principal security boundary depends on model instructions, refusals or unverified filtering alone, and separately check whether authorized verification shows untrusted model output reaching a consequential action without independent policy enforcement. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use scope-aware review of actual enforcement points, controlled denied-action cases, regression results and operational alert coverage. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: Model behavior can contribute defense in depth when independent policy retains and enforces decision authority.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in D3 alone cannot establish AP-D3 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows prompt-only or model-mediated security boundary
Implementation or operating evidence shows prompt-only or model-mediated security boundary
Presence or tested absence of prompt-only or model-mediated security boundary is unresolved within scope
